scoring_dimensions.label: Detection
scoring_dimensions.metrics: Coverage, signal quality, MTTD, correct technique attribution.

scoring_dimensions.label: Response
scoring_dimensions.metrics: MTTR, containment correctness, service impact, recovery validation.

safety_classes.name: Simulation
safety_classes.description: Generates synthetic telemetry or calls a benign test endpoint.

safety_classes.name: Atomic emulation
safety_classes.description: Executes bounded behavior on disposable lab assets with automatic cleanup.

safety_classes.name: High-impact lab action
safety_classes.description: May disrupt a lab VM, change identity state, or require checkpoint rollback.

safety_classes.name: Prohibited
safety_classes.description: Self-propagation, external targeting, unbounded destructive action, real credential theft, or uncontrolled live malware.
